verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own Docs & Files tool keeps documents, images, PDFs and linked cloud files (Figma, Google Docs, Dropbox) organized inside each project, so shared docs sit alongside the project's other work. Its rich-text content supports lists, block quotes, formatting and inline attachments. Native authoring of docs and notes is implied by the feature name but not explicitly described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating native docs/notes and folder-level organization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work

citations.quote: Docs & Files keeps images, documents, PDFs, even cloud files from Figma, Google Docs, and Dropbox neatly organized inside your projects.
Rich text content may contain lists, block quotes, simple formatting, and inline attachments such as mentions, images, and files.
